reviews.author: Katie Godley
reviews.text: Lyon Metal Roofing in Jamesville is always very professional and helpful. I always buy my metal from them and they help me get custom measurements. I’ve never had a bad experience with them and will continue using them in the future.

reviews.author: Steven Spruill
reviews.text: Great people , great prices. Talked with Chris and Steve both are very knowledgeable. I drove from Hampton, VA for the prices. I got a quote here for around 1400- 1500 and Lyon roofing cost me about 700. WOW! I have told every one I know thinking about metal roofing to call them, the whole staff was great. the service was also fast.

reviews.author: Carlton Paul
reviews.text: First class guys, called my order in Tuesday and it was waiting for me at 10 am today. They loaded me up and I was gone in all of 30 minutes, very professional two guys.

reviews.author: Todd Johnson
reviews.text: Went to find answers about why my metal roof was leaking at the roof line. They suggested I check and make sure that all the baffles were put in under the roof cap. I checked and found that there were some missing and that most of the other ones were not in place. Went back and got the ones they suggested and the wife and I put them on that afternoon. Very knowledgeable and pleasant and offered another solution if the one I used does not work satisfactorily, but am thinking it will. If I ever have any more questions they WILL be the first place I go.

reviews.author: Chris Matthews
reviews.text: Great Experience. The guys at Lyons made the process very simple and very quick. At a great price too!

reviews.author: Lori Fuller
reviews.text: The guys that work here are so knowledgeable and very helpful. Will be dealing with this company again. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Chris Smith
reviews.text: I like this local business. Fast service on custom cuts and bends. Made my storage building project a lot simpler by using metal.

reviews.author: Roberto Gomez
reviews.text: Best metal roofing in Eastern,NC great prices and great customer service will used more for my roof metal needs.

reviews.author: Steve Chapman
reviews.text: Had what i needed to complete my project,and got more material for another why i was there. Staff knowledgeable on material and applications .
